uxSocial.communityBody: City updates and conversations with your community.
uxSocial.temporaryCity: You are viewing another city's community. Temporary access ends at the approved expiry time.
uxSocial.chatChannelBody: Join the conversation in this channel.
uxSocial.updatesEmpty: No updates yet. Published announcements will appear here.
uxSocial.crewChatEmpty: Your reservation summary is above. Message crew here about approval and your deposit.
uxSocial.visitCityBody: Choose an event, then request only the access you need. Access requests are separate from reservations and check-in.
uxSocial.membershipRequired: A personal membership is required for this activity. Contact PATS support from Account if you need help.
uxSocial.noOtherCityEvents: No upcoming events in other cities
uxSocial.noOtherCityEventsBody: Return to Events to see events in your own city.
uxSocial.chooseVisitEvent: Choose the event you plan to visit.
uxSocial.visitEventUnavailable: The event you opened is unavailable for a visit request. Choose another event explicitly to continue.
uxSocial.eventAccessBody: Crew in the destination city reviews this request. Approval permits event access until the shown expiry; crew still confirms check-in. This does not reserve a table or sofa.
uxSocial.hubAccessBody: HQ reviews this separate request. Approval grants temporary access to the destination city's community until the shown expiry. It does not approve event attendance or a reservation.
uxSocial.requestPending: Pending — waiting for review. See your access requests below.
uxSocial.reservationTerms: This sends a request. Status will be Pending until crew approves it; a request does not confirm your booking or check-in.
uxSocial.depositTerms: Arrange your deposit (DP) with crew outside the app. Booking approval and deposit payment are separate. An active reservation without a recorded deposit can block another reservation.
uxSocial.unpaidBlock: Open My reservations and contact crew about the active reservation whose deposit has not been recorded.
uxSocial.slotUnavailable: This slot is no longer available or the guest count is invalid. Edit the request before sending.
uxSocial.bookingUnavailable: The reservation summary is unavailable. Return to My reservations to review the booking.
uxSocial.minimumChargePending: Confirm the minimum charge with crew before approval.
uxSocial.recordDepositBody: Record money that crew has already received outside the app. This does not charge the member or change the confirmed booking.
uxSocial.recordDepositConfirm: Record {amount} as received for {slot} at {event}? This saves your receipt record and can allow the member to request another reservation.
uxSocial.depositCrewHelp: Record receipt through the authorized reservation payment tool. The app will show it after the payment record is saved.
uxSocial.chooseOperatingCity: Choose the city to review before making a staff decision.
uxSocial.adminRequired: Open this staff task with Admin mode enabled in Account. Your authorized role and city scope still apply.
uxSocial.mutedBody: Members currently muted in your authorized city scope.
uxSocial.unmuteBody: Restore {name}'s ability to post in this city community?
uxSocial.screenshotHistoryBody: Historical screenshot reports across your authorized cities. These are records, not pending approval requests.
uxSocial.noQueueItems: There are no requests in this view.
uxSocial.noReservationsBody: Reservations for this view will appear here. Start a new request from its event.
uxSocial.accessDecision: Apply this decision to {name}'s request for {type} at {event}? This does not change their reservation or check-in.
uxSocial.reservationDecision: Apply this booking decision to {name}'s reservation for {slot} at {event}? Deposit receipt remains separate.
uxSocial.cancelReservationBody: Cancel the reservation for {slot} at {event}? Crew will see the cancellation. Contact crew separately about any deposit already paid.
